name: After recital AB
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: ABa. whereas the Commission has abandoned its plans to introduce a mandatory harmonised EU-wide front-of-pack nutrition labelling scheme; whereas nutritional information should be based on robust scientific evidence, take into account the overall nutritional value of food products and respect the diversity of traditional European diets and food products; whereas Member States should retain the flexibility to determine appropriate nutritional information measures, in accordance with the principle of subsidiarity;
